subject: Capacity scenarios and staged pool sizing for Orion Health + Vector Labs
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Capacity scenario input - Orion + Vector (initial ask)

Hi team,

Orion has come back with higher usage projections on two potential deals (their platform expansion + a PoC for Vector Labs). They want a three-region commitment suggestion (US/EU/APAC) mapped to deal tiers so procurement can sign a single addendum.

High level asks:
- Can we size three pool scenarios (Conservative / Target / Aggressive) with token-per-second throughput and peak concurrent sessions per pool?
- For APAC specifically, they asked whether we can phase in a smaller dedicated pool and then scale to full capacity after 90 days.
- Include friction points for SLA (cold start, cross-region failover) and a recommended rollout timeline.

I’ve attached a quick baseline workbook (orion_capacity_model_v2.xlsx). Marcus, could you take the lead on the sizing matrix? Neha, please flag any billing/pricing constraints and whether we should route APAC traffic to a nearby region temporarily while on-boarding. Lauren — we’ll likely need a short mutual action plan for procurement and legal.

Target: have a customer-facing proposal by next Friday (Dec 11).

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity scenario input - Orion + Vector (initial ask)

Thanks Rachel — I pulled the baseline compute and traffic assumptions from the workbook and ran three scenarios. Summary (very brief):

1) Conservative:
   - US: 4x A40 equivalent (pool capacity ~ 40 concurrent gen sessions, 250 tps aggregate)
   - EU: 3x A40 equiv (30 concurrent, 180 tps)
   - APAC: 1x A40 equiv (10 concurrent, 60 tps) — routed to APAC edge with burst to US

2) Target (recommended):
   - US: 8x A100-80GB equiv (capacity ~ 120 concurrent, 800 tps)
   - EU: 5x A100-80GB equiv (70 concurrent, 420 tps)
   - APAC: 3x A100-80GB equiv (40 concurrent, 240 tps) — staged: start with 1x + 90-day ramp to 3x

3) Aggressive:
   - US: 12x A100-80GB (180 concurrent, 1.2k tps)
   - EU: 8x A100-80GB (110 concurrent, 660 tps)
   - APAC: 6x A100-80GB (80 concurrent, 480 tps)

Key notes/questions:
- APAC staged rollout is feasible but requires a temporary routing policy (edge + prefix cache) to keep latency acceptable until full pool is available. That adds ~12-18% operational risk to meet strict 100ms p95 targets.
- Billing: staged pools will need clear amortization language in the contract (we shouldn’t bill full reserved rates until committed pool size is achieved).
- We should propose a 90-day ramp with a pre-agreed scale trigger (usage or X% of target tps).

I’ll attach the scenario worksheet and a simple cost delta table.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: orion_capacity_model_v2.xlsx
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava O'Neil <ava@vectorlabs.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 02:36:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Capacity scenario input - Orion + Vector (initial ask)

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:

- Orion is comfortable with a staged APAC start if there is a clear SLA for failover to EU and predictable billing while we ramp. We cannot accept open-ended overage exposure in the first 60 days.
- For Vector’s PoC, they expect low sustained throughput but high concurrency (spiky inference during business hours in APAC). That suggests we should prioritize concurrency over sustained tps for that pool.
- Legal will want an explicit clause that defines when Redwood will be considered to have ‘failed to scale’ during the staged ramp (i.e., missed scale triggers 3x in 7 days).

Can you include a proposed fallback routing policy and a suggested wording for the ramp/overage section? Also, can you propose a small credit/ SLA buffer for the first 90 days as a gesture to accelerate the procurement decision?

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Cloud Ops, Orion Health
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity scenario input - Orion + Vector (initial ask)

Following up with procurement-ready language and a pricing note. Draft suggestions:

- Billing during staged ramp: bill at 50% of reserved monthly rate for capacity that is provisioned but not yet fully committed, with monthly reconciliations based on actual measured tps/concurrency and documented scale triggers.
- Overage protection: cap chargeable overage at 25% above reserved rate for first 90 days; after 90 days standard overage rates apply.
- SLA credit buffer: 5% credit on monthly invoice if we miss agreed p95 latency targets more than twice in a 30-day window during the first 90 days.

I’ve drafted contract language and a short MPA (mutual action plan) template — attaching SLA matrix and risk callouts (sla_risk_matrix.pdf).

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Lead Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: sla_risk_matrix.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.ai>, Ava O'Neil <ava@vectorlabs.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity scenario input - Orion + Vector (initial ask)

Samir / Ava — attaching the customer-facing proposal we’ll share with procurement tomorrow. Highlights:

- Recommended: Target scenario with APAC staged rollout (1x -> 3x over 90 days) and pre-agreed scale trigger (70% of target tps for 14 days).
- Pricing: staged-billing at 50% of reserved rate; overage cap 25% first 90 days; 5% SLA credit buffer for misses during ramp.
- Operational: fallback routing policy to EU within 150ms p95, KV prefix warm-up for common prompts during initial 30 days, and a plan for cross-region KV sync.
- Next steps: sign MPA + PO by Dec 22 to secure Q1 provisioning window.

Attachments: orion_capacity_model_v2.xlsx, sla_risk_matrix.pdf, staged_rollout_timeline.png

Thanks everyone — I’ll book a 30-min procurement sync for Tue (Dec 14) 09:30 PT — calendar invite to follow.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
